module_dispositions.rationale: Filename component syntax, assembly, termination, rendering, and host-name packing.
Pre-string-pool format-file defaults, bounded packing, ambient format lookup, and host-resolved opened-name recovery belong to format bootstrap rather than tex-command or tex-exec.
Expanded filename scanning, recursion guard, job-name state, derived names, and interactive retry.
Lazy DVI naming/open, texput fallback, log catch-up, retry selection, and banner output. §§537–538 are intentionally owned by input-tokenization.json as tex82.input.start-input-and-first-line.
DVI byte-language, preamble, font-definition, rule-alignment, and postamble specification needed to interpret emitted shipout bytes.
DVI state, buffering, signed encoding, font definitions, and first-page preamble.
Movement stacks, byte-width selection, reuse, pruning, and shipout coordinate initialization.
Horizontal-list recursion, positioning, rules, glue rounding, leaders, fonts, and whatsit visits.
Vertical-list recursion, positioning, rules, glue rounding, leaders, and whatsit visits.
Page framing, count capture, dimension guard, page accounting, and box retirement.
End-of-job nesting completion, postamble, used-font definitions, padding, and no-page path.
Page history, insertion records, totals, frozen specifications, contribution state, and output-active state.
Fresh-page reset plus box 255 and insertion-box validation recovery.
Outer-vertical contribution draining, discardability, topskip, totals, maximum depth, and break legality.
Badness, penalty, insertion-penalty cost, champion replacement, and forced-break selection.
Insertion-class records, correction glue, scaled capacity, split selection, and insertion penalties.
Output penalty, mark history, selected-page boundary, box 255 packaging, and page reset.
Insertion queue preparation, accepted prefixes, split remainders, heldovers, and record retirement.
Dead-cycle fallback, output-routine activation, and the default output path.
Output-token recovery, group teardown, box 255 validation, list order, nest restoration, and builder resume.
Extension overview and canonical base-whatsit subtype and field representation.
Numbered output-stream state and all-closed initialization.
Base extension selectors and primitive installation.
Runaway-write diagnostic identity and command-name rendering support scanner and dispatch properties.
Extension commands dispatch in every mode.
Procedure declarations and locals have no independent executable assertion.
Whatsit scanning/construction, copy/free ownership, packing neutrality, and zero dimensions.
Language-state visitation, page and vertical-break transparency, and h/v shipout dispatch.
Position-synchronized DVI special encoding.
Shipout-time write expansion, selector routing, stopper retirement, and unbalanced-write recovery.
Stream effect dispatch, leader suppression, filename defaulting, and immediate execution.
Automatic and explicit language whatsits and captured hyphenation minima.
End-of-job closure of still-open numbered output streams.

properties.claim: A scanned file name is represented as area, name, and extension; scanning stops at space or a noncharacter token, the final area delimiter resets extension recognition, the first later dot begins the extension, and printing/packing concatenates area, name, and extension in that order.
preconditions: Filename scanning has begun with empty delimiter state and string-pool capacity is available.
stimulus: Feed simple names, explicit areas, multiple dots, a space terminator, and a noncharacter terminator to the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: The three components and backed-up noncharacter match §§511–520; packed and printed spellings preserve their canonical concatenation.
postconditions: The filename builder is finished once and leaves no name scan active.
equivalence_cases: A simple alphanumeric name and the same name with empty explicit area/extension produce equal components.
recovery_cases: String-table exhaustion follows §517 overflow; a terminating noncharacter is backed up for ordinary delivery.

properties.claim: scan_file_name expands the first nonblank token and subsequent character tokens while name_in_progress prevents recursive filename scans; job_name begins unset, derived output names reuse it, and an unavailable file prompts for a replacement only in interactive modes while applying the requested default extension.
preconditions: Expanded token delivery and interaction mode are explicit; current filename fields are writable.
stimulus: Exercise expandable names, a backed-up control sequence, recursive input during a name scan, unset/set job names, extension defaults, and retry modes in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: The scan returns exact components, preserves the first nonfilename token, blocks recursive start_input, and produces the TeX82 retry or fatal path.
postconditions: name_in_progress is false after a completed scan and replacement filename fields are ready for another open attempt.
equivalence_cases: An explicit extension and the same replacement name plus its supplied default open the same logical target.
recovery_cases: Nonstop and batch retry abort with the §530 fatal file error; recursive filename initiation is suppressed by the §527 guard.

properties.claim: The DVI file is opened lazily at first shipout from job_name plus .dvi, using texput when no job name exists; log opening similarly derives .log, catches up the first input line after its banner, and retries an unavailable transcript with the canonical selector exception.
preconditions: Job name, first input line, clock/banner fields, selector, and host open outcomes are explicit.
stimulus: Run the structured Phase 2 units below and tiny boundary fixture `job-output-names.tex` with named and unnamed jobs plus one retry.
expected_observations: DVI/log names, open timing, banner fields, copied first line, log_opened, and selector transitions match §§532–536.
postconditions: A successful log open has caught up exactly one first-line transcript and restores terminal/log selection.
equivalence_cases: A job initially named texput and an unnamed job use the same output stems; explicit job names change both suffix-derived outputs together.
recovery_cases: An unavailable DVI/log target requests another name in interactive mode; an unavailable transcript temporarily permits terminal output even from batch mode.

properties.claim: The DVI writer opens lazily, emits one preamble before the first page, preserves byte order across half-buffer swaps and final flush, encodes signed four-byte quantities big-endian, removes redundant buffered pop, and defines a font with checksum, sizes, and external name before first selection.
preconditions: A page has passed the §641 dimension guard and supplies fixed clock, magnification, font, and filename state.
stimulus: Exercise buffer boundaries, signed values, removable/nonremovable pop, and first/reused fonts in the structured Phase 2 units below and byte fixture `shipout-dvi-byte-stream.tex`.
expected_observations: The preamble appears once; buffering does not alter bytes; four-byte values and font definitions match §§592–603.
postconditions: DVI cursor, buffer half, font-used set, and output filename describe the bytes already written.
equivalence_cases: Streaming and contiguous emission are byte-identical for the same commands.
recovery_cases: A huge page is rejected by §641 before §617 opens or writes the DVI stream; an empty final buffer flush writes no extra byte.

properties.claim: Horizontal and vertical movement records choose the shortest signed opcode, reuse or rewrite eligible w/x/y/z movements, retire records at pop boundaries, prune records created inside a finished box, and initialize TeX and DVI coordinates plus the first-page preamble state at shipout entry.
preconditions: Movement stacks contain only live records from the current DVI nesting history.
stimulus: Exercise every signed-width boundary, found/not-found reuse state, already-shipped and buffered rewrites, pruning, and page offsets in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Decoded coordinates match requested motions and opcode reuse follows §§604–617 without crossing a retired boundary.
postconditions: Movement stacks contain no record local to a completed box and shipout initialization starts with null current font.
equivalence_cases: Fresh right/down commands and valid w/x/y/z reuse produce equal coordinates.
recovery_cases: A movement whose reusable byte is no longer buffered cannot be rewritten and uses the canonical alternate state or fresh command.

properties.claim: hlist_out preserves a baseline and left edge, pushes only nested output, selects fonts before characters, recursively positions shifted boxes, resolves running rule height/depth, applies cumulative glue rounding, and places a/c/x leader boxes across the resolved horizontal extent.
preconditions: A finite packed hlist supplies glue sign/order/ratio and valid child nodes.
stimulus: Traverse mixed characters, ligatures, shifted empty/nonempty boxes, rules, kern/math nodes, adjusted glue, and all leader kinds in the structured Phase 2 units below.
The committed command-semantic shipout-hlist case pins §640's ship_out dispatch and the resulting page artifact identity as a regression anchor.
expected_observations: Bytes and positions match §§618–628; child recursion restores the caller baseline and DVI positions.
postconditions: The hlist exits at its original nesting depth with its local movements pruned.
equivalence_cases: Empty and nonempty child boxes advance by the same width after their distinct output paths.
recovery_cases: Nonpositive rules emit no rule but still advance width; nonpositive leader boxes or extents emit no copies.

properties.claim: vlist_out preserves a left and top edge, recursively positions shifted boxes by height and depth, resolves running rule width, applies cumulative vertical glue rounding, and places a/c/x leader boxes down the resolved extent while restoring caller coordinates.
preconditions: A finite packed vlist supplies glue sign/order/ratio and valid child nodes.
stimulus: Traverse shifted empty/nonempty boxes, rules, kerns, adjusted glue, all leader kinds, and nested hlists/vlists in the structured Phase 2 units below.
The committed command-semantic shipout-vlist case pins §§629–630's vlist traversal through a distinct shipped page artifact identity.
expected_observations: Bytes and positions match §§629–637 and nested output returns to the caller left edge.
postconditions: The vlist exits at its original nesting depth with local movements pruned.
equivalence_cases: Empty and nonempty child boxes consume equal height-plus-depth after their distinct output paths.
recovery_cases: Nonpositive rules emit no rule but still advance vertically; nonpositive leader boxes or extents emit no copies.

properties.claim: ship_out reports and optionally displays the box, rejects any page exceeding the four §641 dimension bounds, otherwise emits bop with count0–count9 and previous-bop pointer, traverses the root, emits eop, increments total_pages once, resets dead_cycles, and flushes the shipped box.
preconditions: A complete hlist or vlist box and live count, offset, tracing, and DVI state are available.
stimulus: Ship valid h/v roots with distinct counts and offsets, then cross each huge-page bound in the structured Phase 2 units below and byte fixture `shipout-counts-and-rejection.tex`.
expected_observations: Valid pages add exactly one bop/body/eop and page count; rejected pages add none and show the canonical huge-page diagnostic.
postconditions: The input box is flushed and dead_cycles is zero after either path.
equivalence_cases: Explicit shipout and default output call the same ship_out routine for equal boxes.
recovery_cases: Each huge-page predicate takes the §641 deletion path and, when tracing_output is nonpositive, displays the deleted box.

properties.claim: Final DVI cleanup closes unfinished output nesting, reports no output without pages, or writes postamble summaries, all used-font definitions, post_post, and at least four 223 bytes through the next four-byte boundary before closing the file.
preconditions: Execution has reached final cleanup with internally consistent DVI summary state.
stimulus: Finalize zero-page, one-page, multipage, used/unused-font, and unfinished-nesting states in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Every postamble field and padding byte follows §§642–643; zero pages never opened the DVI file.
postconditions: A nonempty DVI is closed after its final buffer flush and has one postamble.
equivalence_cases: Streaming and owned writers produce identical final bytes for equal pages.
recovery_cases: The zero-page branch reports no pages; live output nesting is closed with canonical pop/eop bytes before the postamble.

properties.claim: The page builder separates accounted page nodes from pending contributions, maintains sorted per-class insertion records and eight page quantities, freezes vsize and maxdepth when content changes from empty, initializes output_active and insertion penalties, and suppresses page draining while an output routine is active.
preconditions: Outer vertical page, contribution, insertion, mark, and parameter state exists.
stimulus: Start with marks/whatsits, insertion-only, and box pages; change vsize/maxdepth around the freeze boundary; call during output_active in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: page_contents, page_goal, page_max_depth, totals, insertion ordering, and diagnostic display match §§980–990.
postconditions: Frozen page specifications remain fixed until the page is fired.
equivalence_cases: Cold and memoized page episodes have equal canonical state independent of allocation identity.
recovery_cases: An output-active build_page call returns without moving a contribution; page display marks heldover state without mutating it.

properties.claim: Starting a new page clears its node/history and last-item state; box_error diagnoses, displays, flushes, and voids an unexpected box, while ensure_vbox applies that recovery only when an insertion register contains an hbox.
preconditions: A page has ended or a canonical box-255/insertion-box validation point has been reached.
stimulus: Reset populated page state and validate void/vbox/hbox registers in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Fresh state and diagnostics/deletion match §§991–993.
postconditions: No stale current-page node, depth, last glue/penalty/kern, or invalid hbox remains.
equivalence_cases: Void and vbox insertion registers both pass ensure_vbox unchanged.
recovery_cases: Nonvoid box 255 and hbox insertion registers take box_error and become void after displaying their contents.

properties.claim: build_page drains contributions in order when output is inactive, updates last-item enquiries, discards leading glue/kern/penalty, delays a terminal kern, inserts adjusted topskip before the first box/rule, moves marks/whatsits/insertions through their canonical branches, and updates height, depth, stretch, shrink, and maxdepth.
preconditions: Contribution and current-page lists are well formed and output_active is false.
stimulus: Contribute every vertical node kind at empty/nonempty boundaries, terminal kerns, topskip edges, and each glue order in the structured Phase 2 units below and fixture `page-contribution-accounting.tex`.
expected_observations: Every node is discarded, delayed, or moved once; totals and last-item enquiries match §§994–1004.
postconditions: If no break fires, contributions are empty and their tail is reset.
equivalence_cases: Glue and kern breakpoints with equal resolved size update the same totals after their distinct legality tests.
recovery_cases: Infinite-order shrink emits the canonical diagnostic and replaces that glue with finite normal shrink; arithmetic overflow stops before linking the current node.

properties.claim: At each legal breakpoint the page builder computes underfull/overfull badness, combines penalty and insertion penalties under TeX82 thresholds, replaces the champion on equal or lower cost, snapshots insertion pointers and page goal, and fires on awful cost or eject penalty.
preconditions: Page totals and a legal breakpoint penalty are available.
stimulus: Exercise exact fit, finite/infinite stretch, shrink equality/overflow, penalty thresholds, insertion penalty 10000, equal champions, and eject penalty in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Badness, cost, latest champion, best size, best insertion pointers, and fire decision match §§1005–1007.
postconditions: A nonfiring breakpoint leaves the current page live with one coherent champion snapshot.
equivalence_cases: Different stretch orders all yield zero underfull badness when any infinite component is nonzero.
recovery_cases: Overfull beyond shrink and insertion penalties at least 10000 force awful_bad; eject penalties fire regardless of badness.

properties.claim: The first insertion of a class creates one ordered record, validates its box, captures existing box height and skip correction once, scales demand by count, and either accepts it within page/dimen capacity or records one vertical split whose null or penalty break contributes insertion penalties while later nodes float.
preconditions: A complete insertion node and live class count, dimen, skip, and box register are available.
stimulus: Exercise repeated/interleaved classes, count boundaries, capacity boundaries, finite/infinite correction shrink, and null/penalty splits in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Class record, page goal, height, split pointers, and penalties match §§1008–1011.
postconditions: Records remain sorted and insertion content remains owned for fire_up.
equivalence_cases: Count 1000 and equivalently scaled other counts reserve the same page space.
recovery_cases: An hbox class register takes ensure_vbox recovery; infinite correction shrink reports the insertion-specific error; a null split adds eject_penalty.

properties.claim: fire_up records output_penalty and rewrites a chosen penalty to inf_penalty, advances top/first/bot marks, walks exactly to the best break, packages the selected nonheld page into box 255 using best_size and page_max_depth, returns the suffix to contributions, and starts fresh page state.
preconditions: A best break, best size, current page, contribution suffix, marks, and insertion choices exist.
stimulus: Fire penalty/nonpenalty and trigger-equal/earlier breaks with zero/one/multiple marks in the structured Phase 2 units below and fixture `output-fire-up-packaging.tex`.
expected_observations: output_penalty, rewritten node, marks, selected prefix, box 255 dimensions, suffix order, and reset match §§1012–1017.
postconditions: Selected page and returned contributions are disjoint and preserve source order.
equivalence_cases: A page without marks inherits first_mark from top_mark; marked pages derive first/bot from their ordered mark nodes.
recovery_cases: A preexisting box 255 is diagnosed and deleted before packaging through §1015 box_error.

properties.claim: Unless holding_inserts is positive, fire_up prepares selected class boxes as append queues, transfers each accepted insertion prefix, splits and prunes the chosen remainder with its captured split_top_skip, repackages the class box, holds remainders and unselected insertions in order, counts heldovers, and frees every page insertion record.
preconditions: Per-class best pointers and current-page insertion nodes correspond to the selected page break.
stimulus: Exercise accepted, unselected, floating, null-split, nonempty-remainder, multiple-same-class, multiple-class, and holding_inserts cases in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Class boxes, remainders, heldover order/count, split-top pruning, and record retirement match §§1018–1023.
postconditions: Every insertion node or content list has exactly one destination after distribution.
equivalence_cases: holding_inserts preserves insertion nodes in box 255; ordinary distribution preserves equivalent relative order through class boxes and heldovers.
recovery_cases: An hbox class register takes ensure_vbox recovery before queue append; an empty split remainder deletes the insertion instead of holding it.

properties.claim: fire_up reports an output loop and falls through to default output when dead_cycles reaches max_dead_cycles; otherwise a nonnull output routine enters one output group in internal vertical mode and increments dead_cycles. The default path prepends heldover insertions, ships box 255, and voids the register.
preconditions: fire_up has prepared box 255 and any heldovers; output_routine and dead-cycle parameters are live.
stimulus: Exercise null output, dead-cycle below/at maximum, heldovers, and a balanced user routine in the structured Phase 2 units below and fixture `output-selection-default.tex`.
expected_observations: Selected path, diagnostic, mode/group/token-list entry, heldover placement, shipout, and box 255 state match §§1024–1025.
postconditions: A user routine leaves output_active true for §1026; default output returns with box 255 void.
equivalence_cases: Null output and dead-cycle escape use the same default list/shipout path apart from the output-loop diagnostic.
recovery_cases: At max_deadcycles the selected page is shipped by default after the canonical error instead of entering another output group.

properties.claim: Output completion checks that only the output token list or backed-up input remains, consumes to its end after an unbalanced-routine diagnostic, ends paragraph and output group, clears output_active and insertion penalties, deletes a leftover box 255 with its diagnostic, appends output material after heldovers and before contributions, pops the output nest, and resumes build_page.
preconditions: A user output routine is active in its implicit group with a saved outer page/contribution state.
stimulus: Complete balanced, unbalanced, leftover-box, output-material, heldover, and pending-contribution routines in the structured Phase 2 units below and fixture `output-resume-recovery.tex`.
expected_observations: Diagnostics, token draining, group/mode teardown, list order, restored nest, and resumed page activity match §§1026–1028.
postconditions: output_active is false, box 255 is void, insertion penalties are zero, and outer vertical mode owns the combined contributions.
equivalence_cases: An empty output list and one containing nodes share identical teardown except for the canonical splice.
recovery_cases: Unbalanced output consumes through its own list end; leftover box 255 is displayed, flushed, and voided before resume.

properties.claim: The sixteen numbered output streams have paired file/open state, streams 16 and 17 are permanently nonfile fallbacks, initialization marks all selectors closed, and final extension cleanup closes each still-open numbered file.
preconditions: Output-stream state is initializing or final cleanup has begun.
stimulus: Initialize all selector states and finalize sparse open/closed stream tables in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Selectors 0–17 begin closed; final cleanup closes only open files 0–15.
postconditions: After final cleanup no numbered stream remains open.
equivalence_cases: Never-opened and explicitly closed streams are equal no-ops during final cleanup.
recovery_cases: Out-of-range fallback selectors are never passed to file close; repeated closed entries remain untouched.

properties.claim: TeX82 installs openout, write, closeout, special, immediate, and setlanguage as extension commands with selectors 0 through 5, and main_control routes extension in every mode to do_extension with the exact selector.
preconditions: Base primitives are being installed or an extension command has reached main_control.
stimulus: Resolve and dispatch all six primitives in outer/internal vmode, hmode, and math mode in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Raw command identity and selector match §§1344 and 1347 before subtype-specific scanning.
postconditions: Exactly one do_extension branch receives each recognized selector.
equivalence_cases: The same primitive has the same command/selector identity in every mode; setlanguage legality is checked inside its own branch.
recovery_cases: An unknown extension selector takes TeX82 confusion ext1 rather than silently succeeding.

properties.claim: new_whatsit appends one typed node; openout scans a four-bit stream, closeout and write normalize arbitrary stream integers to slots 0..17, write stores unexpanded text, special stores expanded text, and copy/free preserve subtype-sized fields and token references. Slots 16 and 17 are permanently closed, so closeout on either is a silent no-op. These base whatsits contribute no box dimensions.
preconditions: Subtype dispatch and scanners have explicit current-list ownership.
stimulus: Construct, display, copy, free, and pack every subtype with stream boundaries and scan-time macro changes in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Fields, scan timing, rendered form, allocation size, token ownership, and zero width follow §§1349–1361.
postconditions: Construction appends exactly one complete node and copying leaves both payload owners valid.
equivalence_cases: Copied specials share fixed scan-time text; copied writes share deferred unexpanded text.
recovery_cases: Out-of-range write streams clamp to 16/17; malformed text scanning completes its scanner recovery before a complete node is exposed.

properties.claim: Line-breaking and pre-hyphenation visits update language state only at language whatsits; page building carries every whatsit without creating a breakpoint; vert_break skips it; and hlist/vlist output delegates it exactly once to out_what at its list position.
preconditions: A well-formed node list contains base whatsits among ordinary nodes.
stimulus: Visit every subtype through line breaking, pre-hyphenation, page building, vert_break, hlist_out, and vlist_out in the structured Phase 2 units below.
expected_observations: Each consumer performs only its §§1362–1367 action; no passive visit scans, expands, opens, writes, closes, or emits a special itself.
postconditions: List order and dimensions are unchanged by passive visits.
equivalence_cases: Hlist and vlist visits call the same out_what payload at different coordinates; page and vert_break both preserve node ownership.
recovery_cases: A contentless whatsit on an otherwise empty page does not freeze page specs or become a legal breakpoint.

properties.claim: special_out synchronizes horizontal and vertical DVI coordinates, renders the stored token list without expansion, chooses xxx1 for payloads shorter than 256 bytes and xxx4 otherwise, emits the exact bytes, and releases only its temporary rendered string.
preconditions: A special whatsit has reached out_what at a valid shipout coordinate.
stimulus: Emit lengths 0, 255, 256, and multibyte TeX character payloads at shifted positions in the structured Phase 2 units below.
The committed command-semantic special-whatsit case pins §1344's extension dispatch code and the §1368 special whatsit's placement in the enclosing hlist.
expected_observations: Opcode, length field, payload, and anchor position match §1368.
postconditions: The stored token list remains available for copied-box shipout.
equivalence_cases: xxx1 and xxx4 cases differ only in canonical length encoding for equal payload prefixes.
recovery_cases: A scan-time truncated diagnostic representation is not used; special_out requires the complete stored list produced by §1354.

properties.claim: write_out surrounds stored write text with synthetic braces and an outer endwrite stopper, enters mode zero, fully expands through scan_toks at shipout time, consumes and retires the stopper list, then writes one line to an open numbered stream or the canonical terminal/log fallback selected by stream 16/17.
preconditions: A write whatsit has reached out_what and its stored unexpanded token list is valid.
stimulus: Vary meanings between scan and shipout, selectors 0/16/17, newlinechar, copied boxes, and balanced/unbalanced braces in the structured Phase 2 units below and fixture `deferred-write-boundaries.tex`.
expected_observations: Expansion time, output selector, exact line bytes, and input-list retirement match §§1369–1372.
postconditions: mode and selector are restored and no used-up endwrite input list remains.
equivalence_cases: Immediate and deferred write bytes agree only when relevant meanings and newlinechar are unchanged.
recovery_cases: An unbalanced write reports the canonical error and consumes through endwrite without absorbing following source input.

properties.claim: out_what executes open/write/close only outside leaders: write calls write_out; open first closes the selected numbered stream, defaults an empty extension to .tex, retries until open succeeds, and marks it open; close closes and marks it closed. immediate recognizes only open/write/close, executes the temporary node once, frees it, and otherwise backs up its expanded lookahead.
preconditions: A base effect whatsit reaches out_what or immediate has obtained one expanded lookahead token.
stimulus: Exercise open/reopen/write/close, extension default, unavailable-open retry, leaders, recognized immediate operations, and unrecognized immediate lookahead in the structured Phase 2 units below and fixture `open-write-close-effects.tex`.
expected_observations: File state, line output, leader suppression, temporary-node retirement, and lookahead backup match §§1373–1375.
postconditions: Deferred nodes remain in their owning list; immediate recognized nodes leave no list node.
equivalence_cases: Immediate and deferred effects agree when no intervening state changes, aside from execution time.
recovery_cases: Leader traversal performs no open/write/close; failed open prompts for another name; unrecognized immediate input is backed up unchanged.

properties.claim: fix_language appends a language whatsit only when normalized language changes and captures normalized left/right hyphen minima; setlanguage is legal only in horizontal mode, always appends after scanning, normalizes operands outside 1–255 to zero, and updates clang.
preconditions: Horizontal paragraph language and hyphen-minimum parameters are live.
stimulus: Exercise automatic same/changed language, all normalization boundaries, minima boundaries, explicit same-language append, and illegal modes in the structured Phase 2 units below.
The committed command-semantic setlanguage-replay case observes the canonical main-control replay path.
expected_observations: Append count, language, minima, and clang match §§1376–1377.
postconditions: Each appended node freezes its minima for later §1362 visitation.
equivalence_cases: Negative, zero, and above-255 operands all select language zero.
recovery_cases: Outside horizontal mode setlanguage reports illegal case without scanning or appending.
